target.title: fix(google-meet): reject nondecimal transcript cursors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `googlemeet transcript --since` accepted hexadecimal and exponent spellings such as `0x10` and `1e0`, silently converting them to different cursor offsets before gateway delegation. Operators resuming from a documented decimal `nextIndex` could therefore request the wrong transcript slice.

## Why This Change Was Made

The transcript cursor now uses the same strict non-negative integer parser as other Google Meet numeric CLI options. Invalid spellings are rejected at the CLI boundary before `googlemeet.transcript` is invoked, while canonical decimal values including `0` continue to route unchanged.

AI-assisted.

## User Impact

`googlemeet transcript --since` now only accepts canonical decimal cursors. Hex, exponent, and fractional spellings fail fast with the existing `--since must be a non-negative safe integer` message instead of reaching the gateway as a different offset.

## Evidence

### Real registered CLI action proof

Validated on exact pushed head `d634eca76c92e8127e0fcf742c540f196a3d7025`, rebased onto `35fb5ee81ac`.

The proof harness calls the production `registerGoogleMeetCli` Commander action with an injected gateway delegate, matching the real CLI registration path used by the Google Meet plugin.

**Before (upstream/main):**

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google-meet/src/cli.transcript-since-proof.test.ts --reporter=verbose

PROOF since=0x10 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":16}}
PROOF since=1e0 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":1}}
PROOF since=0 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":0}}
PROOF since=3 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":3}}
```

**After (this branch):**

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google-meet/src/cli.transcript-since-proof.test.ts --reporter=verbose

PROOF since=0x10 result={"error":"--since must be a non-negative safe integer"}
PROOF since=1e0 result={"error":"--since must be a non-negative safe integer"}
PROOF since=0 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":0}}
PROOF since=3 result={"method":"googlemeet.transcript","payload":{"sessionId":"session-1","sinceIndex":3}}
```

This shows the production CLI action previously forwarded `0x10` as `sinceIndex: 16` and `1e0` as `sinceIndex: 1`, and now rejects both before gateway delegation while preserving canonical `0` and `3`.

### Focused regression

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google-meet/src/cli.test.ts -t "transcript cursor|non-decimal transcript|cursor-based transcripts"` — 7 passed
- `git diff --check`

No live Meet session, gateway, or OAuth credentials were required.
